annotations.title: US and EU cyber incident reporting deadlines

description: Incident-reporting clocks under SEC Form 8-K/6-K, NYDFS Part 500, the US bank 36-hour rule, HIPAA, the FTC Safeguards Rule, NIS2, DORA, GDPR and the EU Cyber Resilience Act, each from its own trigger. Give aware_at (and decided_at for materiality/classification clocks) for wall-clock due times.

aware_at.description: Optional. When the entity became aware, ISO 8601 with offset.

bank_service_provider.description: A bank service provider under the same rule.

cra_manufacturer.description: A manufacturer of products with digital elements under the EU CRA.

decided_at.description: Optional. When materiality/reportability/major classification was determined, ISO 8601 with offset.

ftc_safeguards.description: A non-bank financial institution under the FTC Safeguards Rule.

gdpr.description: GDPR role for the personal data involved.

nis2.description: An essential or important entity under NIS2.

nydfs.description: Regulated by the New York DFS (23 NYCRR 500).

us_bank.description: A US banking organisation under the 36-hour computer-security incident rule.
